name: retrofit-plugin
description: Additive framework provider for Retrofit/OkHttp networking. Auto-detected from the Gradle version catalog / build files; enriches the `network` aspect (enriches_aspect: network) via framework.md (additive: true) with the retrofit-conventions skill, development + security phase-prompt injections, and R8/ProGuard keep rules. Ships NO agents — it specializes the existing development / security phase prompts. Reference implementation of the Framework Provider Pattern.
